description: GROND, 7-channel simultaneous imager (g'r'i'z'JHK) of MPE on the MPG 2.2 m at La Silla: filter curves published by the instrument PI.

licence.terms: No licence or terms statement for the filter curves on https://www.mpe.mpg.de/~jcg/GROND/. The page says "GROND data are not publicly available - please contact the PI (jcg@mpe.mpg.de)." (about observational data; the filter-curve file is linked publicly under 'GROND Documentation').
licence.scope: No data licence found. Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: GROND home page: 'GROND has been built by the high-energy group of MPE in collaboration with the LSW Tautenburg and ESO. GROND is operated as a PI-instrument at the MPI/ESO 2.2m telescope on La Silla (Chile).' The curve file's first column is labelled 'A' but is in nm.
